NATIONAL FOREWORD
The Indian Standard (Part 1) (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 22241-1 : 2019 —Diesel engines — NOx reduction agent AUS 32 — Part 1: Quality requirementsâ€™ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Petroleum and their Related Products of Synthesis or Biological Origin Sectional Committee and approval of the Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division Council.
